changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Whether the last read of a pull request from its provider reached the end of its threads, reviews and comments. A GitHub read could stop after its first page without saying so: 5 threads or reviews or 10 comments on a live read, 20 threads, 50 reviews or 10 comments on a backfill. A list that holds exactly a first page cannot prove it is whole, so such rows start as not read whole, and the next read of the work settles them.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE issue SET discussion_read_whole = FALSE WHERE issue_type = 'PULL_REQUEST' AND provider_id IN (SELECT id FROM identity_provider WHERE type = 'GITHUB') AND (id IN (SELECT pull_request_id FROM pull_request_review_thread GROUP BY pull_request_id HAVING COUNT(*) IN (5, 20)) OR id IN (SELECT pull_request_id FROM pull_request_review GROUP BY pull_request_id HAVING COUNT(*) IN (5, 50)) OR id IN (SELECT issue_id FROM issue_comment GROUP BY issue_id HAVING COUNT(*) = 10))
